latest_release.name: Concat v0.2.9
latest_release.body:
## Concat 0.2.9

### Highlights

- ✨ **Transitions are clips.** A transition sits on the timeline and is placed, moved and trimmed like any other clip, over a cut or on a single shot. Its own knobs (Push's direction, a wipe's softness, a whip's speed) are set on it (#621)
- ✨ **Transparent projects.** A clear background with a checker under the preview, or a background colour of your choice, and export with alpha as ProRes 4444 or VP9 (#456)
- ✨ **Chroma key that finds the screen itself**, an eyedropper, Remove Black, and batch edits in the inspector (#543, #470)
- 🗣️ **Your own voice.** Import a recording on the Voices shelf and keep it as a voice with a name, picture and description (#518)
- ✨ **Speed curves** on the Speed tab: drawn, from a preset, smooth or straight (#322)
- 📝 **Styled words in a title.** Give some of a title's words their own colour, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough or size, plus text case and typography controls (#529, #450)
- ✨ **Captions in the language spoken.** Pick it, and whisper listens only to the speech. Each caption starts when its words do (#231, #619, #438)
- ✨ **Effects and sounds as layers.** Drag a picture effect or a sound effect onto the timeline and it covers everything under it
- ✂️ **Fade knobs** on a sound's corners: drag along the clip to fade it in or out

### Export

- 📤 About 2.4x faster at 4K: frames are drawn two ahead and handed to the encoder as YUV, and the encoder runs on its own thread
- 📤 H.264 and HEVC use the platform's own encoders, GPU first. HEVC falls back to Kvazaar on the CPU, and H.264 to OpenH264 where Windows has no encoder
- 📤 AAC uses Apple's encoder on a Mac and iPhone, Microsoft's on Windows, and Android's on a phone. A mix ends on its last sample
- 📤 A Mac's hardware export follows the quality you ask for, not VideoToolbox's own bitrate
- 📤 The last frame is drawn, with no black frame after it, and a clip after two transitions in a row no longer vanishes
- 📤 Running out of video memory is an error the export recovers from, not a hang

### Faster

- ⚡ Scrubbing shows the nearest picture at once and the exact frame when you stop (#472)
- ⚡ An idle app trims its frame caches and gives the memory back
- ⚡ Imported cards show their pictures at once, and phone filmstrips come from keyframes
- 🗣️ Enhance runs on the GPU in Concat's own compute shaders: 4.2 s per 1080p frame, where ONNX Runtime took 27. It works only on the span a clip shows and reuses repeated frames

### Editing

- ✂️ Up and Down jump to the previous and next cut. New projects offer 4:5 and 3:4
- ✂️ A quick split follows the playhead (#538). Keyframe diamonds are larger and open the Keyframes pane (#490)
- ✂️ Linkage: captions, titles, overlays and sounds move with the main track
- ✂️ The tab strip scrolls instead of running off the pane (#567)
- 🐛 Copy, paste and duplicate carry every clip setting, and a paste into another project plays the right file
- 🐛 ⌘Q saves the project (#437). File › Open and recent projects close the open one first, saved
- 🐛 A missing file is noticed when the window comes back, and the relink dialog opens on it (#409)

### Media

- 📁 Screen recordings and variable-frame-rate clips play every frame at its moment (#457)
- 📁 MKV, WebM, FLV, WMV, MTS/M2TS, .ts, .mpg, HDV and DV footage shows the right picture at the right width, wherever you seek (#457)
- 📁 Sound stays in sync in files whose streams start at different times (#457), and a trimmed clip's sound starts at its cut (#535)
- 📁 SVG imports as a still, WebM alpha is kept (#429), and Save Audio As writes a WAV Concat can open again (#544)

### Windows

- 🐛 Direct3D 12 compiles shaders with FXC, never a stray dxcompiler.dll on PATH (#418), and every effect's shader builds there (#548)
- 🐛 On a software adapter the window draws on the CPU and the monitor on a device of its own (#503, #480)
- ✨ A **Concat (safe graphics)** Start menu entry (`concat --software`) for anyone whose window is drawn as coloured squares

## About Concat is a free, open-source video editor for macOS, Windows, Linux and Android. It covers what most edits need: auto-captions, text-to-speech, background removal, keyframe animation, effects and titles, multi-track cutting, 4K export. With none of the catches: no watermark, no account, no subscription, no upload. Everything runs locally on a native Rust engine with a GPU compositor. Install it, drop in footage, cut. The AI models for captions, voices and cutout download once from Settings and work offline after that. Your footage never leaves your disk. **Good for:** TikTok, Reels and Shorts, YouTube videos, tutorials and screen recordings, podcast clips, memes. **Also for machines:** a built-in MCP server for AI agents (`concat --mcp`, [set up](docs/MCP.md)) and a JSON-RPC API for scripts, so they can cut video with it too. ## Highlights - 🚫 **No watermarks. No account. No paywall.** Ever. - 🔒 **100% local.** Nothing uploads. Works offline. - 💬 **Auto-captions.** Local Whisper. Pick a model size, get styled captions on the timeline. - 🗣️ **Text-to-speech + voice cloning.** A free local voice on the desktop, or any voice from a few seconds of a recording. Phones are getting their own system voice. - 🧍 **Background removal.** People, objects, or paint the mask yourself. - 🎞️ **Keyframes.** Position, scale, rotation, opacity, volume, effect parameters. Curve editor built in. - ✨ **100 effects, filters and transitions.** GPU-rendered, live in the preview. - ✂️ **Cut fast.** Split, trim, ripple, merge, freeze frame, speed. Magnetic timeline if you want it. - 🎚️ **Multi-track, multi-timeline.** Overlays and picture-in-picture: stack video, stills and titles on as many tracks as you like. Several cuts in one project. Blend modes (screen, add, multiply…), crop, flips. - 📝 **Titles.** Fonts, stroke, shadow, background plate. Presets to start from. - 🎙️ **One-switch voice cleanup.** Denoise, enhance voice, level the loudness. Plus chipmunk, robot, telephone and friends. - 📤 **Export.** H.264, HEVC, AV1. Up to 4K 60, 10-bit colour. - 🦀 **Native Rust engine.** GPU compositor, proxies, hardware decode. 4K scrubs smoothly. - 🤖 **Scriptable.** An MCP server built in, so Claude and other AI agents can edit with it ([one line to set up](docs/MCP.md)), and a JSON-RPC API for scripts. A build from source adds gRPC and a command-line tool. - 🖥️ **macOS, Windows, Linux, Android.** 26 languages. Same app, same project files. ## Download Two ways in: 1. **[The website](https://concat.standalones.org/#download)** hands you the right build for your machine. Start here. 2. **[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/jub0t/Concat/releases)** has every build for every platform, with installers, packages and checksums. For when you want to pick. Concat is in **beta**: it works, and it still has edges. [Say so](https://github.com/jub0t/Concat/issues) when you find one. **Platforms** - ✅ **Windows** · x86_64 (ARM builds are paused, see [#326](https://github.com/jub0t/Concat/issues/326)). A setup and an `.msi`. If SmartScreen stops an unsigned build: **More info** › **Run anyway** - ✅ **macOS** · Intel and Apple silicon. If macOS refuses to open an unsigned build: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Concat.app` - ✅ **Linux** · x86_64 and ARM. `.deb`, `.rpm`, `.AppImage` and an Arch package. Also a Flatpak on **[Flatpark](https://flatpark.org/apps/app.concat.editor/)**, a community Flatpak remote that wraps the x86_64 `.deb` of each release and updates with it - ✅ **Android** · phones and tablets - ✅ **iOS / iPadOS** · iPhone and iPad, sideloaded ✅ Supported · 🚧 Work in progress · 🧪 To be tested **System requirements** and the optional model sizes are on [the website](https://concat.standalones.org/guides/system-requirements). **[Code signing policy](CODE_SIGNING.md)**: why the Windows builds are not signed yet, and what Concat sends over the network (nothing you did not ask for). ## Build from source You need Rust 1.93 or newer (see `rust-version` in `src/Cargo.toml`), the FFmpeg 7+ development libraries, cmake and a C++ compiler. - **macOS:** `brew install ffmpeg` - **Windows:** from [FFmpeg's Windows downloads](https://ffmpeg.org/download.html#build-windows), take BtbN's `win64-gpl-shared` build (the one CI uses), unpack it and point `FFMPEG_DIR` at it - **Linux:** use your distro's FFmpeg if it is version 7 or newer, otherwise use a BtbN `shared` build with `FFMPEG_DIR` like on Windows Then: ```sh cd src cargo run -p concat # the editor window ``` Other useful commands: ```sh cargo build --profile app -p concat # the shipping binary (fat LTO, stripped) cargo test # run the test suite cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings # what CI checks ``` If you change text the interface shows, run `python3 scripts/locales.py` from the repo root so the string inventory stays in sync. Full details live in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ## How to Contribute > [!IMPORTANT] > The best way to contribute is to grab a build from the [Releases](https://github.com/jub0t/Concat/releases) page and use it: find where it breaks, and say where it could be better. > > Ready to write code? [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) covers setup, the layout of the tree, the checks to run, and how contributions are licensed. Driving Concat from a script, a service or an agent? [The developer docs](https://concat.standalones.org/docs) cover the Concat API and its transports: JSON-RPC and gRPC; [docs/MCP.md](docs/MCP.md) connects an AI agent over MCP. [This Discussion](https://github.com/jub0t/Concat/discussions/3) is where the project was announced. > > Contributors can claim a `@Contributor` role in the Discord server: just ask. ## Star History ## Contributors ## Licence Concat is free software under [AGPL-3.0-or-later](LICENSE). A commercial licence is available for closed-source use; see [LICENSING.md](LICENSING.md). ## DMCA If you believe something in this repository, its releases, or a package or model it distributes infringes your copyright, email [jub0trd@gmail.com](mailto:jub0trd@gmail.com) with a description of the work you own, a link to where the infringing material appears here, your contact details, a statement that you believe in good faith the use is not authorised by you, your agent, or the law, and a statement, under penalty of perjury, that the notice is accurate and that you are the owner or authorised to act for the owner, signed with your physical or electronic signature; valid notices are acted on promptly, and anyone whose material is removed may send a counter-notice to the same address.
